Policy_Category.description: The user-authored category contract binds the category namespace and its definition to user-selected fields. It can also bind other namespace boundaries, category responsibilities, and excluded responsibilities.

SchemaVersion.description: Version of the PTSIP-owned public Policy schema.

Version.description: When present, the dedicated user-contract validator checks the officialVersion definition or a user-authored version schema.

officialVersion.description: Numeric major.minor.patch with an optional approved prefix and suffix and an optional numeric build and build revision.
